Selfless Elf 5k

Dec 19 2026

14th annual Selfless Elf 5k

Register today for the 14th annual Selfless Elf 5k benefiting your Akron-Canton Regional Foodbank. Enjoy a morning of fun for the entire family while supporting local hunger relief. New this year, custom bibs! Sign up early to secure your custom bib with your name.

6:30am Registration begins
8:00am Race begins at the Akron-Canton Regional Foodbank
350 Opportunity Pkwy, Akron OH 44307
